description: Search the 15,000 comuni of every era and the foreign states of the ANPR archive by name or by code (codice catastale like H501, Z-code like Z110). Returns up to 20 places with their province and the dates their code was valid. Give a date to keep only the places valid on it.

date.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD: only places valid on that day.
